name: Kaiser Permanente Walnut Creek Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
city: Walnut Creek, CA (1425 South Main St)
what_you_do: You greet members and guests and walk visitors to where they need to go in the hospital. It is a nonclinical role, so there is no job or clinical shadowing.
who_can_apply: High school students age 15 or older. You must give one 3 to 4 hour shift a week on the same day and time, and stay in the program for your whole high school career. The high school track is at Walnut Creek Medical Center only.
duration: One 3 to 4 hour shift a week, for the rest of high school
deadline_text: No deadline posted. On 2026-10-16 the Walnut Creek High School Programs listing showed an Apply button, but its Status line was blank.
how_to_apply: Go to the Kaiser volunteer site. Open High School Programs at Walnut Creek and click Apply. You will log in or sign up as a new volunteer. Questions? Call 925-295-5487.
notes: Read on Kaiser's volunteer site on 2026-10-16. kp.org links to it at kpvolunteer.samaritan.com. This is a long commitment. The page says it lasts all through high school. The page does not list shots, a TB test or fees. It does not say if a parent must sign. Kaiser does not offer job shadowing. Adult volunteers here also cover nearby offices. The high school track is at Walnut Creek only. Kaiser's old volunteer link no longer works, so use kpvolunteer.samaritan.com. The Pleasanton and San Ramon offices said on 2026-10-16 that they are not taking high school students right now.
